blocks.text: Fire hose reel system
Installation, Maintenance & Testing in the UAE

A fire hose reel system gives building occupants a fast, first-response option for tackling a fire before it spreads, using a permanently connected hose housed in a wall-mounted cabinet. Firestone Fire and Security Systems installs, inspects, and maintains fire hose reel systems across commercial, residential, and industrial properties in the UAE, built and tested to civil defence requirements.
Get a free quote
What a Fire Hose Reel System Does

Unlike a fire extinguisher, a fire hose reel stays connected to a pressurized water supply at all times, so it can be unwound and used immediately without needing to be recharged or replaced after use. It's typically positioned at regular intervals through corridors, stairwells, and open areas, giving occupants or trained staff a way to control a fire in its early stages while waiting for the fire brigade.
Our Fire hose reel services
Fire Hose Reel Installation

Our fire hose reel installation service includes reel and cabinet placement based on travel distance and coverage requirements, connection to the building's wet riser or dedicated water supply, and pressure testing before handover. Cabinet finishes and mounting can be specified to match the building's interior where required.
Fire Hose Reel Inspection

Routine fire hose reel inspection confirms the reel unwinds freely, the hose shows no cracking or damage, the nozzle and valve operate correctly, and the cabinet remains accessible and clearly signed. These checks catch small issues, like a stiff valve or a partially blocked cabinet, before they become a compliance finding.
Fire Hose Reel Maintenance

A fire hose reel maintenance visit goes beyond a visual check, testing water flow and pressure at the nozzle, servicing the reel mechanism, and replacing worn hose sections or fittings where needed. We schedule maintenance under an AMC so testing happens on a set cycle rather than being left until an inspection is due.
Fire Hose Reel Testing

Testing confirms the system delivers adequate flow and pressure at the furthest hose reel on the network, not just the ones closest to the water supply. Results are recorded and kept on file to support civil defence inspections and Istifa documentation.
Why You Need a Fire Hose Reel System

A fire hose reel gives building occupants a way to act in the critical minutes before the fire brigade arrives, when a fire is often still small enough to control. Waiting for external response alone can allow a contained fire to spread well beyond what a single hose reel could have stopped early on.Fire hose reels are also a standard civil defence requirement for most commercial and multi-occupancy buildings in the UAE, not an optional addition. Missing or non-functional hose reel coverage can affect a building's completion certificate, Istifa, or ongoing occupancy approval, the same way an incomplete hydrant or riser system would.
Signs Your Fire Hose Reel Needs Attention
Hose is stiff, cracked, or discoloured
Reel doesn't unwind smoothly
Nozzle is difficult to turn
Cabinet is blocked, damaged, or missing signage
Any of these should be addressed through a maintenance visit rather than left until the next scheduled inspection.
Where Fire Hose Reels Are Required

Hose reel placement is based on travel distance, not just floor area — civil defence guidelines require reels positioned so that no point in a building is beyond a set hose-and-jet reach. Common locations include:

blocks.text: Everything you need to know about our fire hose reel systems

items.q: What is a fire hose reel system?
items.a: A fire hose reel system is a wall-mounted, permanently connected hose supplied by pressurized water, allowing building occupants to respond to a fire in its early stages before the fire brigade arrives.

items.q: How often should a fire hose reel be inspected?
items.a: Fire hose reels should be visually inspected regularly and functionally tested at set intervals to confirm the hose, valve, and cabinet remain in working order and compliant with civil defence requirements.

items.q: What is the difference between a fire hose reel and a fire extinguisher?
items.a: A fire hose reel stays connected to a continuous water supply and can be used repeatedly without recharging, while a fire extinguisher has a fixed amount of extinguishing agent and must be replaced or refilled after use.

items.q: Do fire hose reel systems need civil defence approval?
items.a: Yes. Fire hose reel systems in the UAE must be installed and maintained by a civil defence-approved contractor, with spacing, hose length, and signage meeting ADCD, DCD, or SCD requirements depending on the emirate.
